scope: Small development controls; no width27 census
controls.json: One row per partition, characteristic and target degree; actual Gaussian ranks and predicted maximal ranks, with characteristic hypothesis recorded
parts: Nondecreasing positive bit-width partition; radix is 2^part
degree: Target degree of multiplication by L^2; source degree is degree-2
large_characteristic_hypothesis: p exceeds sum(radix-1); only then maximal rank is asserted
nonmaximal_small_characteristic_maps: Count of actual explicit_rank != maximal_rank; these are retained expected negative controls
replay: Repeat native control generation into a fresh directory and compare controls.json byte-for-byte
r1_and_r2: Both retained; r2 adds four invalid-argument rejection tests and is the accepted executable
